name: Multiadmin — Simplifies admin, secures your site, and accelerates your site
author: MULTIDOTS Inc

sections.description:
Your WordPress admin is cluttered by default — filled with menus you don’t need, security gaps you didn’t know existed, and features that silently slow your site down. Multiadmin fixes all three with one lightweight plugin, no coding required.

Simplify your dashboard. Hide or reorder admin menus so you and your team see only what matters. Less noise, faster navigation, fewer mistakes.

Harden your security in seconds. Disable XML-RPC, enforce stronger passwords, and turn on essential protections — all from a single settings panel.

Speed up your site. Remove WordPress features that load on every page but serve no purpose for your setup: emoji scripts, oEmbed, query strings on assets, and more.

Make it yours. Change admin colors, icons, and branding to match your preferences or your client’s identity — no extra plugins needed.

Key Features & Functionalities:

  • Simplify Your Admin Menus
    Remove, reorder, or hide dashboard menu items so each user sees only what’s relevant to their role — less confusion, fewer mistakes, faster onboarding.
  • One-Click Security Hardening
    Disable XML-RPC and enforce stronger passwords across all user roles in seconds — no security background or separate plugin needed.
  • Remove Performance-Draining Features
    Turn off emoji scripts, embeds, and unnecessary default features that slow your site down — no code, no theme changes required.
  • Personalize Your Admin Branding
    Change admin colors, icons, and branding to match your workflow or your client’s identity — hand off a polished dashboard that reduces support requests.
  • Distraction-Free Dashboard
    Remove default widgets no one uses so every user sees only what matters to their role — a cleaner workspace from day one.
  • Enforce Stronger Password Policies
    Require stronger passwords across all accounts with one setting — every login meets your standard automatically.
  • One Plugin. Four Jobs Done.
    Multiadmin replaces separate cleanup, security, performance, and branding plugins — one lightweight install, no monthly fee, no data leaving your site.

Who Is It For?
Multiadmin is built for WordPress site owners, freelancers, content creators, and agencies who want a cleaner, faster, and more secure admin — without stitching together four separate plugins to get there.

External Services

This plugin connects to Jetpack to manage site subscribers.
It sends the site ID when checking subscriber data and redirects users for management.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the better-by-default folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the settings page Multiadmin’ to customize options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work on multisite installations?

Yes, Multiadmin is compatible with multisite installations. You can activate it network-wide or for individual sites.

Can I revert changes made by this plugin?

Yes, disabling the plugin will revert any admin customizations made by Multiadmin.

Does this plugin affect the front end of my site?

No, Multiadmin only makes changes to the WordPress admin dashboard and backend settings. It does not impact your site’s appearance or functionality for visitors.

Can Multiadmin improve my website’s performance?

Yes, the plugin removes unnecessary features that can impact site performance, leading to a more efficient and faster website.

What security enhancements does Multiadmin offer?

Multiadmin provides simple settings for stronger security, such as disabling XML-RPC and enforcing stronger passwords, helping to protect your website from potential threats.

How do I troubleshoot conflicts with other plugins?

Disable other plugins one by one to identify conflicts. If the issue persists, contact our support team for assistance.

How do I get support if I face an issue?

You can post your queries on the WordPress.org support forum for the plugin.
